name: SWC Skyweight Championship
epitaph: The Sooner Wrestling Council's cruiserweight-style title, weight-limited to 225 pounds, set out in the promotion's own founding handbook alongside its Television, Heavyweight and Heavyweight Tag Team titles. No champion is recorded before the promotion's trail runs cold.
notes: Named in the founding handbook's own titles section; no holder or title match survives in any document read.

name: SWC Television Championship
epitaph: The Sooner Wrestling Council's number-two title, billed as defended every week. A first-round tournament to crown its inaugural holder was previewed for the promotion's own debut supercard, but no result survives.
notes: The promotion's own 26 January 1999 newsletter previews a three-match first-round tournament and an unrevealed-stipulation finals bout to crown the first champion at the 31 January 1999 debut card; no result of that card survives.

name: SWC Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The Sooner Wrestling Council's top title, billed to go to the winner of a twenty-entrant Royal Rumble at the promotion's own debut supercard. No result of that show survives.
notes: The promotion's own 26 January 1999 newsletter previews the Royal Rumble main event for the 31 January 1999 debut card; no result survives.

name: SWC Heavyweight Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The Sooner Wrestling Council's tag team title, set out in the promotion's own founding handbook. No champions or title match are recorded in any document read.
notes: Named in the founding handbook's own titles section; no holder survives in any document read.
